messages:
jamie: Quick sync — we need a policy crosswalk for onboarding compliance across US, UK, and DE. Goal: update handbook sections + create a single checklist for hiring ops by next Tuesday. Who can take the lead?

nina: I can start the crosswalk. I have a spreadsheet with current clauses. Linking: https://bit.ly/rdw-policy-crosswalk-2026 (view only for now).

samir: Important to flag contractor vs employee differences. Hiring ops keeps hitting the wrong checklist for EOR hires. Can we add a 1-line discriminator on the checklist?

ajamie: @samir good call. Nina — can you add a column 'engagement_type' with values: employee | contractor | EOR?

nina: Yep. Done. I added the column and populated a sample row for DE hires.

alex: I'll handle the LMS assignment rules once the crosswalk is stable. Question: do we make the trainers optional for contractors?

kelly: From compliance reporting POV, contractors still need data-privacy and security baseline training within 14 days. Managers should be able to mark exemptions only with People Ops approval.

jamie: New checklist items we need:
- policy crosswalk link
- handbook section IDs (US/UK/DE)
- engagement_type column
- LMS course IDs for required trainings
- manager-approval flag

nina: I added a 'handbook_refs' column with short IDs. Example: US-HB-3.2, UK-HB-1.4, DE-HB-2.0

samir: Can we add a quick CSV export header so hiring ops can integrate? Something like:
```
email,full_name,engagement_type,role,team,location,first_day,handbook_refs
```

alex: Perfect. I'll wire up the LMS import to that header. Also, LMS course IDs: PRV-101 (Data Privacy), SEC-201 (SecOps), HR-ONB (Handbook Overview).

kelly: Current completion rates (new hires last 90d): PRV-101 89%, SEC-201 76%, HR-ONB 95%. We need a nudge flow for SEC-201.

jamie: Action items:
- nina: finish crosswalk + exportable CSV (due in 24h)
- alex: draft LMS import mapping + nudge flow suggestion (due Tue)
- samir: update hiring ops templates to use engagement_type discriminator (due in 48h)
- kelly: write manager approval wording for exemptions and add to People Ops playbook (due Tue)

nina: On it. I'll also add a 'required_by_role' column so senior infra roles trigger SEC-201 immediate enrollment.

hr-bot: Reminder scheduled: "New hire compliance packets must be assigned within 48 hours." Next run: 2026-04-05 09:00 UTC.

samir: Small UX ask — in hiring ops form can we add a checkbox "EOR - verify local contract" that auto-populates engagement_type=EOR? Saves a ton of follow-ups.

alex: Yes, I'll add that to the import mapping and send a sample payload.

kelly: One more: for DE hires we need to surface the local works council notice step. Nina pls flag any handbook refs that require local admin action.

nina: Flagged DE-HB-2.0 -> note added: "notify works council; retain document for 6 months."

jamie: Great. If no blockers, I'll close this thread and create a single checklist template in Confluence with the CSV header and task owners. Will ping the hiring-ops channel once done. :white_check_mark:

kelly: Thanks all. :thumbsup:

alex: Thx — will post mapping.

nina: Uploading final crosswalk in 2h.

jamie: Closing note: keep comments inline on the spreadsheet rather than here to keep the thread tidy.
